events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Marking 30 years since the tragic shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your top Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No.

angles.name: Bond Favourite
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme song? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. What's his most important song to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the passing of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: "Rubber Soul" 61st Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album "Rubber Soul" was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their evolving sound. What's your stand-out track?

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless message of peace and love.
